verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents its own outbound webhooks and an Events API for Directory Sync updates, which covers directory user and group changes. Its Rust SDK also includes webhook helpers, so registrable programmatic callbacks exist. However, nothing in the pack shows events for AuthKit sign-ups or sign-ins, or a general auth event stream. Missing for 10: documented sign-up/sign-in/authentication event types, webhook registration and signature-verification docs, an event catalog beyond Directory Sync, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to webhooks or event streams for auth events (sign-ups, sign-ins, user changes) to keep my systems in sync

citations.quote: Directory updates can be delivered to you via webhooks or retrieved using the Events API.
Directory Sync sends automatic updates to your app for changes to directories, groups, users, or access rules.
includes helpers for common WorkOS flows such as AuthKit, SSO, webhooks, sessions, JWKS, PKCE, and Vault local crypto.
